question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The chef prepared a delicous meal for the guests.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"delicous"** in the sentence is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"delicious"**.
 
• **"Delicous"** does not have a valid meaning in English, as it is a misspelling. However, the intended word is "delicious," which means highly pleasing to the taste or smell; very enjoyable. (स्वादिष्ट)
 
 
• **Example:** The delicous cake was enjoyed by everyone at the party. (Incorrect spelling)
 
 
 
• The correct spelling is **"delicious"** (स्वादिष्ट), which means something that tastes or smells extremely pleasant.
 
 
• **Example:** The chef prepared a delicious meal for the guests. (Correct spelling)
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Meal** (भोजन): Food that is prepared and eaten at a specific time, typically breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

 
 
• **Example:** We enjoyed a hearty meal after a long day of work.
 
 
 
• **Guests** (अतिथि): People invited to visit or stay at a place, typically for an event or occasion.
 
 
• **Example:** The guests were warmly welcomed into the party.
 
 
 
• **Prepared** (तैयार): Made ready for use or an event; equipped to handle a situation.
 
 
• **Example:** She prepared the room for the visitors ahead of their arrival.
